sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with T.R. Case No.62 of 2024 pending on the file of learned Special Judge, POCSO, Puri arising out of Kanas P.S. Case No.199 of 2023 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 363/376(2)(n) of IPC read with Section 4/6 of POCSO Act.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner has been cited as an accused only because she is the mother of the principal accused.
Hence, she may be protected by pre-arrest bail.
4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner relies on the 164 Cr.P.C. statement and the deposition of the victim to fortify his submission that the Petitioner has no complicity.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes such prayer.

6. Taking into account the nature of allegation qua the Petitioner, who is a lady, this Court directs that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper.
